csv_project_name: AE for Resurfacing W Chestnut Ave(Delsea Dr - Orchard Rd)
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Vineland is seeking proposals from qualified consultants to provide professional design services for the resurfacing of W. Chestnut Avenue from Delsea Drive to Orchard Road. The Consultant will be responsible to perform all necessary survey work for the project. The Consultant will provide mapping in both hard copy and disk on AutoCAD Civil 3D 2026 Format. The Consultant s work will consist of six (6) Tasks: A. Pre-Design B. Coordination C. Survey and Mapping D. Data Collection and Analysis E. Design Task F. Necessary Permitting and/or Approvals
